docs.summary: Posted to the league chat with the words "I have fired my previous counsel. Disregard my previous statement." Reproduced as received. Still does not dispute Exhibit A, now rejects the compliance demands, says he will continue with his current plan, and again reserves rights before the full league or "Executive Council."

docs.title: Reply to Respondent: Consent Agreement & Shoebeer Compliance Audit
docs.summary: Point-by-point reply to the respondent's filing. The facts are undisputed, upside is not a snap, and Potential Points can't be manufactured. On precedent: 47 regular-season no-show starts from 2021 to 2025, spread thin across the league, look like incompetence, not strategy. The Executive Council is the group chat. Commitments entered as a binding Consent Agreement, with weekly Shoebeer audits from Week 7 and a ceremonial shoey for any breach. Nolo contendere accepted.

docs.title: Response to Notice of Violation (Respondent's Filing)
docs.summary: The respondent's written response to Notice SHADY-2026-001.01, reproduced as received. Does not dispute Exhibit A, argues the moves don't violate the Bylaws, claims selective enforcement, asks for prospective application, and commits to compliance from Week 7 while reserving rights before the "Executive Council."

docs.title: Tanking Enforcement: the 2027 1.01 Sweepstakes
docs.summary: Reminder to every bottom-dweller: draft order runs on Potential Points, not your record, so benching studs earns nothing but shame. Starters must be expected to play, empty benches are no excuse, and hoarding injured free agents counts as sabotage. Escalating penalties up to losing your earliest rookie pick. Lose honestly.

docs.title: Cease & Desist: Fielding Non-Participating Personnel
docs.summary: Formal First Offense Warning to a winless franchise caught starting IR and PUP players with no shot at a snap to sink its Potential Points. Starting Week 7: field players who will play, stop collecting injured guys, and acknowledge in league chat by Thursday kickoff. Sentient injury reports are not a valid lineup.
